newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks up in London, property stocks lead rise.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks up in London, property stocks lead rise.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London ended higher in fairly active trading boosted by several big property stocks.
"The index in London is higher and this was related to the big property transactions which went through today," said one dealer.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index ended 102.23 points, or 0.78 percent, higher at 13,201.79. In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng Index closed 67.60 points lower, or 0.51 percent, at 13,099.56.
Dealers said they expected the market to be cautious on Friday, unless Wall Street resumes its advance. -- Lewa Pardomuan +44 171 542 5106
